component.name: TubeHaus
component.summary: Private YouTube client without a Google account

description.p: TubeHaus plays YouTube without a Google account, without ads and without tracking. Your subscriptions, history, playlists and recommendations stay on your computer.

ul.li: Subscriptions, Watch later, playlists and history, imported from Google Takeout or NewPipe if you like
Recommendations made on your device from what you watch
SponsorBlock, Return YouTube Dislike and DeArrow
Captions, chapters, a video queue and audio-only playback
Videos saved to watch without internet
Optionally synced with your own TubeHaus server
